title: ICTSI jumps 7.27%, powers PSEi above 5,600

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks rallied on Friday as a surge in shares of port operator International Container Terminal Services Inc. (ICTSI) pushed the benchmark index above 5,600 despite continued foreign selling. The Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) climbed 2.22 percent, or 121.84 points, to close at 5,611.97. The broader All Shares Index gained 1.39 percent. READ: PSEi slips as profit-taking ends 3-day rally Philstocks Financial Inc. said index heavyweight ICTSI drove much of the rally, jumping 7.27 percent to lead blue-chip gainers.
